post.title: Rent-A-Center's Owner Lost Money on Sales. Rent Paid
post.ig:
Rent-A-Center's parent lost money on its merchandise sales line in 2025. Rent is the business.
Upbound sold $829 million of merchandise in 2025 that cost it $958 million (a -15.5% margin). That line includes early buyouts, where earlier rent already covered part of the item's cost.
Rentals and fees brought in $3.63 billion, about 77% of $4.7 billion in revenue; cost of rentals and fees was about 40% of that.
About 38% of Rent-A-Center store agreements reach ownership (2024 10-K). Q4 2025 lease charge-offs: 4.9% in stores, 10.1% at Acima. Acima added $251 million of 2025's ~$375 million revenue gain.
Sources: Upbound Group 2025 and 2024 Form 10-K; Q4 2025 results (Feb 19, 2026).
